description: This Java class `GeofenceTransitionsIntentService` handles geofence transition events. It listens for geofence enter and exit transitions, communicates with Google Play Services via `GoogleApiClient`, and sends or deletes data items on geofence events, mainly for wearable device communication.

classes.name: GeofenceTransitionsIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that processes geofence transition events. It detects entering and leaving geofence regions, communicates with wearable devices via DataApi, and shows user notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming geofence transition intents; processes entered or exited geofences, sends or deletes data items via Wearable DataApi, and shows toast messages.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message on the main UI thread.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is established.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connection is suspended.
